survey: Round wall clock seen almost straight on. Orange round frame (ellipse ratio 0.95, 0.5% off true): a near-circle at a slight angle. It hangs flush on the green striped wall and its soft shadow shows contact. White dial inset in the frame, concentric and equally round (0.95, 0.4% off). 12 evenly spaced navy hour bars, longer at 12/3/6/9, with minute dots between them. Short thick hour hand near 10 and longer minute hand at 2 (about 10:10, consistent with each other). Thin red second hand with a short tail points to 6 and lies over the 6 bar. All three hands share one central hub on the dial.
